title: Purge — Delete AAS
summary: DELETE every shell already on the target — a bulk teardown, not one addressed delete.
notes: A preparatory step, not a benchmark — it resets the target rather than measuring anything, so its numbers do not belong next to a real run's. Give its Load a high, short-lived rate (a Spike, or a brief Constant well above the corpus size) so it finishes before the rest of the timeline starts; see backend/scenarios/purge-repository.json for the shape this mirrors.
